## Checklist

- [ ] The title is exactly `added <Language> language support`, with the language name capitalized (for example, `added Ukrainian language support`)
- [ ] The folder name is a code from [Chrome's list of supported locales](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/reference/api/i18n#locales)
- [ ] Only the values of the `message` keys were translated; keys, `description` fields and the JSON structure are unchanged
- [ ] Placeholders such as `$SECONDS$` are preserved
- [ ] The languages list in the README is updated
- [ ] I checked how the translation looks in the extension
